dedupe_keys.name: uas thermal imagery of district heating networks for leak detection taseg and leakdet data sets

description: These data sets provide drone-based thermal infrared images of urban areas crossed by district heating networks, prepared for detecting pipeline leaks as thermal anomalies. They were published by Elena Vollmer, Julian Ruck, Rebekka Volk and Marinus Vogl with papers on automatic leak detection. The Thermal Anomaly Segmentation (TASeg) set, recorded near Munich and Karlsruhe in December 2019 and January and March 2021 with FLIR and DJI Zenmuse XT2 cameras on Matrice unmanned aircraft, gives 3,171 images with heuristically generated masks and 269 with hand-drawn masks, split for training, validation and testing, plus a conda environment. The LeakDet record gives the Python leak detection program with an exemplary Munich thermal image set of about 550 MB. Coverage is urban districts near Munich and Karlsruhe. Files are ZIP archives on Zenodo (TASeg July 2025, several GB) under GPL-3.0-or-later at no cost. Caveats: images cover a few flights and seasons, and generated masks are heuristic. Simulation uses are training and testing leak detection for condition monitoring of heat networks. Related records: model-tpldetect uses models trained on these data.
